# algizian_service_account_token (Resource)

A credential (`ag_...`) for a service account. The token is shown once by the API and stored in the Terraform state (sensitive): write it to a secret store from the configuration, and protect the state. Any change replaces the token. Creating one needs an org admin token or a platform token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algizian_service_account_token" "ci" {
  service_account_id = algizian_service_account.ci.id
  name               = "deploy"
  expires_at         = "2027-11-26T00:00:00Z"
  tags               = { purpose = "deploy" }
}

output "ci_token" {
  value     = algizian_service_account_token.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1 to 80 characters.
- `service_account_id` (String)

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 time after which the token stops working; default: never.
- `org` (String) Organization slug; defaults to the provider `org`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Free labels (at most 20; keys start with a letter and use `a-z 0-9 . _ : -`, values up to 256 characters). Algizian never reads them. The map replaces the object's tags as a whole; set `{}` to clear them. Tokens take their tags at creation only, so a change replaces the token.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The token id (not the secret).
- `prefix` (String) First characters of the token, as the API lists them.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The secret.
